regime_context: The detector shows a narrowing eligible breadth (19 of 49 themes; frac 0.39) with AI Infrastructure (ai_infra) as the leader and Cybersecurity as challenger, but the overall view is 'narrowing' and non-directional. Backtest verdict is clear: rank is an attention lens (rank-IC ~0), the ONLY validated edge is the absolute-trend gate for drawdown control (gate_helps=true here), so I produce modest, falsifiable leans and treat rank/durability/crowding as coincident texture.
emerging_watch: Watching Cybersecurity leadership as a CONFIRMED handoff only: if CIBR closes a weekly bar above SMH's 4-week relative performance while Cybersecurity breadth stays above 0.9 AND the rotation margin vs AI Infrastructure flips sign (challenger score exceeds leader), that retires the watch and confirms a leadership change — until then AI Infrastructure remains the leader and no next-narrative call is made.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity is the strongest COINCIDENT trend-health name: eligible, hurst_tag 'trend', breadth 1.0 (the only perfect breadth in the set), durability_bar 0.85 (highest), and it is the challenger by rank. This is a trend-following rather than rank-following read: the absolute-trend gate is the validated leg, and Cybersecurity passes it cleanly. Crowding_z 1.8 flags it as crowded, so this is a size-caution, not a conviction upgrade.
evidence: eligible=true and hurst_tag='trend' (validated absolute-trend gate side)
breadth=1.0 (only perfect breadth in the universe)
theses.dissent: crowding_z=1.8 is the second-highest crowding flag in the eligible set; guardrails warn crowding marks tops and is a SIZE-DOWN caution only, so the crowded texture may cap follow-through exactly when broad participation looks strongest.

falsifier.text: CIBR breaks below its own 50-day average while breadth drops below 0.6 before the check-by date

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: US Energy Complex (XLE) is eligible with hurst_tag 'trend', breadth 0.727 (healthy, not extreme), and only modest crowding (z=0.83). Under 'discipline_not_prediction' this is the cleanest trend-gate candidate: no crowding caution, trend-health validated, breadth supportive. Equal-Weight Energy ranks right behind it with trend tag and lower crowding, confirming the energy leadership is broad rather than single-name driven.
theses.dissent: Energy is a cyclical/rate-sensitive complex and the macro_narrative is dominated by ai_tech with unscheduled_share 1.0; if the AI narrative compresses risk appetite for cyclicals, energy trend-health can deteriorate quickly despite current breadth.

falsifier.text: XLE lags SPY by 5% or breadth falls below 0.5 before the check-by date

theses.subject: Robotics & Automation
theses.thesis: Robotics & Automation (BOTZ) is eligible but carries hurst_tag 'mean-revert' and weak breadth (0.583), with durability_bar 0.56 (below the ~0.68 threshold held by the trend-healthy leaders). The single validated edge is the absolute-trend gate; a mean-revert tag means the trend discipline does not apply constructively here, so I avoid rather than lean either way. This is not a short or fade — just a non-participation read under the gate.
evidence: eligible=true but hurst_tag='mean-revert' (fails the trend-gate leg)
theses.dissent: mean-revert can precede a fresh trend if a catalyst hits; avoiding is not a bearish claim, just declining to express a view where the validated edge (trend gate) offers no support.

falsifier.text: BOTZ flips to hurst_tag 'trend' with breadth above 0.7 and durability_bar above 0.68 before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
